title: CapSign Sign Description Schema
description: A machine-readable description of the compositional layout of a Brazilian road sign (CONTRAN / DNIT IPR-743), sufficient to redraw it. Describes the FACE of a static fabricated sign: its type, colour category, and the panels, lines, arrows, pictograms, shields and badges that compose it. This schema is an interface contract; it deliberately contains no rendering, CAD, or implementation detail.

colorToken.description: A named colour from the CONTRAN palette. Never a hex value.

colorScheme.description: The sign's colour category, determined by the BODY of the sign (not a header module). Maps to a CONTRAN signage category.

justification.description: Horizontal alignment of a module's content.

position.description: Placement of an element relative to its line or module. 'before' = leading edge (left for LTR), 'after' = trailing edge (right for LTR), 'behind' = layered behind the text.

arrowDirection.description: Direction an arrow points. Eight-point compass subset used on guide signs.

fontSize.description: Relative text size. The largest text on the sign is 150; all others are scaled relative to it. Not a point size or millimetre value.

confidence.description: Producer's confidence in the description. 1.0 fully legible/unambiguous; 0.8+ minor uncertainty; 0.6+ partial obscuration with '?' chars; <0.6 flag for human review.

id.description: Pictogram identifier. Either a descriptive lowercase term (e.g. 'fuel', 'rural-tourism') or an official CONTRAN code (e.g. 'A-2a', 'R-19').

network.description: Highway network: 'BR' for federal, or a state abbreviation (e.g. 'PR', 'SP').

number.description: Route number as a string (preserves any leading zeros).

state.description: Optional state abbreviation when the network alone does not disambiguate.

element.description: A graphic element attached to a module or a line: an arrow, a pictogram, or a route shield.

segment.description: A run of text within a line that may carry its own background. Used to build inline mixed-background lines (e.g. a destination followed by a coloured route plate).

lineObject.description: A single line of content within a module.

text.description: The line's text. Use '?' for each illegible character; never complete a word from outside knowledge.

km.description: Distance in kilometres, for orientação signs where this line has a km column. Integer.

segmentArray.description: A line expressed as a left-to-right sequence of segments. Use ONLY when the colour changes inline within one line. A whole line with a single background stays a lineObject with a line-level backColor.

line.description: A module line: either a single line object, or an array of segments for inline mixed-background lines.

module.description: A panel of the sign. Separate modules exist only where a VISIBLE DIVIDING BORDER separates panels; a coloured badge floating inside a panel is a line backColor, not a module.

elements.description: Module-level elements (e.g. an arrow spanning multiple lines).

pictograms.description: For type 'pictograms': an ordered list of pictogram ids.

footer.description: For type 'pictograms': optional footer text below the pictogram row.

width.description: For type 'tree' or 'special': overall width in millimetres.

height.description: For type 'tree' or 'special': overall height in millimetres.
